name: com.ooimi.socks.SocksVpnService
description: OOIMI AndroidLibraryX starts this VPN Service when its SOCKS proxy is turned on. It creates a local VPN tunnel that sends selected app traffic and DNS requests through the configured SOCKS proxy, and keeps the connection running with a notification.
disableEffect: The SOCKS VPN cannot start, so app features that rely on this proxy connection will stop working.
